turns.prompt: Do a full playtest (test every interaction), fix bugs you find (e.g. crashes)
turns.reply:
I ran a full playtest in a headless phone browser and found and fixed three bugs. All three fixes are in PR #110: https://github.com/fischerq/ludumdare60/pull/110

**What the playtest covered:**
- Every scene with random taps, swipes, holds and keys.
- Scripted runs of every hall and lobby interaction with each of its choices, with the lobby at four stages of progress.
- Each deep layer cleared, then NEXT LEVEL, then BACK, in normal and hard mode.
- The maze's game over (with and without coins) and clear, and level 256 through to the credits.
- The adder's overflow.
- The three hall mini games, ending in a win, a loss and a quit.
- The lab, making-of, event, Impressum and manual pages.

**Bugs fixed** (all from leftover state when a scene is entered again; each one happens on the old code and is gone with the fix):
1. **Lobby crash:** pulling the cheat lever that turns off "all subsystems won" crashed the game.
2. **Credits stuck:** the second time the credits played in a session (for example the film reel twice), BACK, ESC and tapping did nothing.
3. **Cabinet hint missing:** coming down to the cabinet a second time with no coins, the "NEED COINS? / LAYER UP" box never appeared.

I also fixed `lab/playtest.html`, whose level tables made the page scroll sideways on a phone; they now scroll inside their card. It still requests a hard-mode results file that was never committed, but the page handles the missing file without breaking.

Nothing else raised errors. Two things look odd in the test but are how the game is built: credits don't skip on a tap (hold to fast-forward, tap once it's over), and when you're out of coins after a game over only the LAYER UP button works.

**To test on the phone:**
- In the lobby, pull lever 2 (on, then off): the room should restart cleanly.
- Watch the film reel twice: BACK should work both times.
- Spend your coin, go down to the cabinet with none left, go up a layer and come back: the NEED COINS? box should show again.

Plan usage at the end of this turn: about 17% of the 5-hour limit, 50% weekly.

The siren case is already handled. Re-running the lobby sweep with the fix, plus the adder and game-over-with-coins cases with my script fixed.
The deep layers all clear, go up a level and go back without errors (layers 0 and 1 were only slow under load; I checked BACK with real taps). Running the hall's mini games too.

Page scroll fixed. Now checking the three game fixes directly: lever pull in the lobby, credits played twice, and two visits to the cabinet without coins.
All three bugs reproduce on the old code and are gone with the fixes. Taking the screenshot for the making-of, then committing.

The consistency pass is done and in PR #112: https://github.com/fischerq/ludumdare60/pull/112. A scripted re-run of the deep layers, maze, adder and the three machines showed no errors.

- **Pac-Man vs the other machines:** Invaders, Asteroids and Kong now have the maze's HUD: 1UP and HIGH SCORE across the top, and spare lives as icons next to LAYER UP. Each machine remembers its own best score on the phone. Kong's "HELP!" no longer sits under the sound button.
- **Text size:** all HUD text in every game is now the same size (24 screen px, set by `hudPx` in `src/config.js`):
  - The maze HUD is a bit smaller.
  - The deep layers' level, title, subtitle and goals line are 1.5x. The play area moves down to make room.
  - The hall's coin count and the lobby's "INSIDE THE CABINET" title use the same size.
- **Instructions on top:**
  - "SWIPE TO TURN / EAT ALL THE DOTS" is now above the maze, and the maze moved down a bit.
  - In the deep layers, the hint line ("PICK UP THE PATCH" and so on) is under the subtitle. Only the goals counter is still at the bottom.
  - The adder's "TAP: HOP UP / SWIPE: HOP THAT WAY" is under its title, and its LEVEL is top-left like everywhere else.
- **Labels inside the deep layers:** VRAM, TILES, PALETTE, the palette numbers, the frame timer, ROM/RAM/Z80/I/O and MODE SCATTER are drawn twice as big.

**Two instructions I left in place:**
- "TAP THE COIN DOOR" in the cabinet is a box that points at the door, so it stays next to it.
- "FLICK THE COIN INTO THE SLOT" stays at the bottom, because the coin and the BACK button take up the top of that screen.

Say if you want either moved anyway.

**To test on the phone:**
- Play a round of Kong or Invaders and check the 1UP / HIGH SCORE row and the life icons.
- Open the video board and the system bus layers: the labels should be readable and the hint should sit at the top.

Plan usage: about 35% of the 5-hour limit, 55% weekly.
